# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

I couldn't open the retailer pages, so the links below go to the review articles that list each product, except one direct store link. Prices come from those articles and change often, so check the current price before buying.

## My top picks

**1. Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro: best value (~$120 with a code)**
- It lists at $149.99. SoundGuys rated it 8.2/10, and its ANC beat 63% of the earbuds it measured. It also has LDAC, multipoint, wireless charging and IPX5 water resistance. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))
- Dealectric tested the code **AFSC20** in Soundcore's cart on 2026-10-22, and it took the price to $120. It doesn't apply to items already on sale.
- Buy: https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro (this is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission, and you enter the code at checkout). ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-discount-codes))

**2. Nothing Ear (3): best ANC under $150 on any phone**
- It's just under $150 on Amazon. SoundGuys scored its ANC 8.2/10, better than 69% of the earbuds it has measured.
- It has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging.
- Downsides: bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics, and about 5 hours per charge with ANC on. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/), [SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))

**3. Sony WF-C710N: safe, battery-friendly pick (~$119-$128)**
- What Hi-Fi? named it best budget, at $119 at Walmart and $128 at Best Buy and Sweetwater. ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise))
- It gets 8.5 hours with ANC on. It lacks LDAC. ([Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/))

## By phone

- **iPhone:** A renewed AirPods Pro 2 can be had for just under $150 on sale. SlashGear says its ANC and transparency mode are still excellent. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)) The new AirPods 5 with ANC ($129, or $149 with wireless charging) have an open fit, which blocks less noise. ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/))
- **Samsung/Android:** Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro are about $134 new on Amazon, with strong adaptive ANC and IPX7. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))

## If you want to spend less

- **Soundcore P31i** is $59.99 with adaptive ANC and a 4.4-star Amazon average. ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/))
- **Anker Soundcore Space A40** is RTINGS' best budget ANC pick, though its mic is poor for calls. ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds))
- **EarFun Air Pro 4** is Sound Mavericks' #1 pick, but I didn't see a price in the results. That site's rankings also rely on spec sheets and other outlets' measurements rather than its own testing. ([Sound Mavericks](https://soundmavericks.com/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-under-150/))

If you tell me whether you use iPhone or Android, and whether you care more about call quality, battery or ANC strength, I can narrow this to one.
